snippet.title: AlternativaPlatform's Adobe Flash "Molehill" Tanki Online 2.0 demo
snippet.description:
Browser-based multiplayer 3D-action Tanki Online 2.0 will support Flash Player 11 with 3D API Molehill, providing graphics rendering with GPU. Project is based on Alternativa3D 8 engine for new Flash player with hardware 3D support.

Also check:
AlternativaPlatform's Adobe Flash "Molehill" Ostrova Online demo video - http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hCXxCD_GYTA
AlternativaPlatform's Adobe Flash "Molehill" Metro 2033 Online demo video - http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Aein6drd_Hk
AlternativaPlatform's Adobe Flash "Molehill" MAX Racer demo video - http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KcKvS983K8c
AlternativaPlatform's Adobe Flash "Molehill" MAX Racer interactive demo - http://alternativaplatform.com/en/demos/maxracer/
AlternativaPlatform official site - http://alternativaplatform.com
